entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane suffering temporal and planar damage that the heroes try to mend.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who gave her spark and life to close a temporal rift, protecting her sanctum of Skyshroud one last time.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: Freyalise's sanctum protected by closing the rift.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The planeswalker and only being ever to travel through time, who seals the Tolaria rift and is lost.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: An archwizard who cast a spell obliterating countless Phyrexians and himself.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The site of planar damage so severe it could not be healed in the present day.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A character beginning to realize his full potential.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns to Dominaria, angry at Karn's loss and driven by Leshrac.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker working with Jhoira to complete Dominaria's healing.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A character working with Teferi to heal Dominaria.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: An ancient evil intelligence that has returned and drives Jeska's wrath.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Horrors who crossed from an alternate Dominaria through a temporal rift.

entities.name: Future Sight
entities.description: The third Time Spiral block expansion, accompanied by a novel by Scott McGough.

events.summary: Freyalise gives her spark and her life to close a temporal rift that let Phyrexian horrors cross into the present.
events.quote: Freyalise is gone, having given her planeswalker's spark and her life to close that rift

events.summary: Karn enters the Tolaria rift and returns to the moment before Barrin's spell, sealing the rift before it opens; Karn is lost.
events.quote: Karn succeeds and seals the planar rift before Barrin's actions can rip it open.

events.summary: Jeska returns to Dominaria seeking vengeance for Karn as Leshrac returns.
events.quote: Her friend and ally Karn is gone, and someone will pay.

relations.quote: Her friend and ally Karn is gone

relations.note: an evil intelligence drives her wrath
relations.quote: An ancient, evil intelligence drives Jeska's wrath

relations.note: her wrath threatens to undermine Teferi and Jhoira's efforts
relations.quote: threatens to undermine Teferi and Jhoira ’s efforts to complete Dominaria’s healing
